projects.name: 'Instant  Stonehenge' in VR: Re-creation of the 1960 FDR Memorial
projects.description: My late father, Norman Hoberman, was the sculptor for the winning entry of the 1960 F.D.R. Memorial competition, which was sadly never realized. A brilliant but controversial modernist masterpiece, the design was dubbed ‘Instant Stonehenge’ in the popular press, and was ultimately left unbuilt, brought down by the opposition of Roosevelt’s descendants. My project is to re-create the memorial as a virtual reality experience, so that it can finally be experienced immersively at scale.

projects.name: Formula Development for Open Air Mycelium Clay
projects.description: Myco-materials have been used as decorative elements in architectural structures, but the design and mechanical properties of these sculptures are physically constrained by simple molds. This results in block forms, shallow relief, and 3D printed aesthetics. These applications are nascent in form & function, but newer formulations show that myco-materials can be used more broadly, such as clay-like materials. However, current myco-material recipes rely on sterile environments and hand manipulation results in mycelial contamination. To integrate mycelium into existing sculpting techniques, our work expands current formulations to create a repeatable, low contamination risk material. Our previous prototype has successfully proven that this work can be used in a multitude of environments.

projects.name: Plantiverse
projects.description:
Our project Plantiverse started out with an exploration of rights for plants, by giving them autonomy. Building on the Rights of Nature movement's gains of independent legal standing for forests and species, we wanted to see if we could get operational, financial, and maybe even civil rights for non-human living beings.
We gave Herbie (a herb houseplant) a form of their own autonomy, letting them make certain decisions on their own. Sensors measure Herbie's light, soil moisture, water reservoir, humidity and temperature; which are linked to decisions about mobility; so that Herbie, when in need of water or light, will go to the water source / light source.
As Herbie gained decision making power over mobility, we asked ourselves, can non-human beings have economic power? What if Herbie could deliver and sell their own herbs and leaves to people? And if Herbie can sell and “earn” money, could Herbie have a bank account? Could Herbie own things, vote, or even have planetary citizenship?
But how would that manifest in the real world?
So we went to work with Herbie, in fact we enabled a family of plants, Minty, Ivy, Ginger and other plants, with sensors. These sensors, in turn, give readings that are then paired with a particular output of an image, Leave colors, for example, indicate water level, ….
The rendering, then, becomes a visualization of physiological status of the plant itself, essentially a digital twin, or avatar, of the plant in real life.
These visualizations, then were minted in the carbon neutral Solana chain and sold as NFTs or NFTrees. The funds raised via the sales will be directed to sustainable causes.

You are about to die… AGAIN! The year is 2194 and you, plus more than half of the population,
live in a computer simulation called e+erntiy.
Due to our massive carbon footprint, every day the earth looks more and more like Mars. That
didn’t matter to you though, not until Earth was hit with a massive solar flare, which caused
worldwide blackouts.
You are one of the lucky ones. You got turned back on. But the system is unstable. If you don’t
get a secure source of power to the ROOT directory, you will get shut off, this time for good.
There are people willing to help. We contacted teams who have a shot at saving us all.
Their mission is to retrieve a crucial part from San Antonio, TX and bring it down to our ROOT
directory on Antarctica. Their mission will be difficult but not impossible. They will be without
much of the technology they are used to, and communication is limited to radio.
This is where you come in. We need you to help coordinate their efforts, communicate with
them, and guide them through the pitfalls they will inevitably face. You will be able to speak with
them on the radio, and when they reach data centers, you will be able to receive their video
documents.
We are all Running Out Of Time. Guide them well. Our survival depends on it.

As humanity approaches a mass extinction in the form of Climate Catastrophe, TIPPING POINT takes you on a visually arresting, emotionally heart breaking and immediate journey in Virtual Reality. The narrative is told as a traditional three act structure, whilst incorporating dance and music into its storytelling, connecting with the audience on a powerful subconscious level. The cross-pollination of drama, dance and music melds together to create a mind-blowing sensory experience.
The project is in early stage development and is seeking support from partners to produce a pilot scene (prototype) to show the potential of the project. This pilot prototype has generated financial support of AUD$85k from other partners and is looking for a remaining AUD$15 - 20k (USD$9 - 12k) to complete the budget and start work on the prototype.

funds.name: 2.5% Osa Regeneration Fund
funds.subtitle: One tiny peninsula holds 2.5% of Earth's biodiversity. Backing the creators regenerating its land, culture, and community.
funds.description: The Osa Peninsula covers less than a thousandth of a percent of the planet's surface and holds 2.5 percent of its biodiversity. National Geographic called it the most biologically intense place on Earth. The people who live here already know what it needs. The projects exist: farmers and land stewards replanting forest, the Higuerones cooperative growing community-owned livelihoods, Festival Madre Monte gathering artists under the canopy, sea turtle guardians walking the beaches at night. What the peninsula lacks is not vision or effort; it is a platform that lets the world see all of this at once. Curated by Fundacion Osa, rooted in twelve years of weaving this community together, this fund backs the artistic, scientific, and technological innovators regenerating one of the rarest places alive. The forest is already growing. We fund the hands that tend it.

funds.description: The Africa Web3 Fund for Culture and Code supports visionary African artists, scientists, and builders using web3 to shape the continent’s creative and technological renaissance. From NFT art and fashion to regenerative science and public goods, we back projects that blend culture with code to uplift communities and reimagine Africa’s future.

funds.description: Africa is home to one of the world's most vibrant creative communities, yet too many bold ideas never move beyond inspiration because their creators lack access to funding, networks, and institutional support. The AfroForward Fund exists to change that. We support creative entrepreneurs, artists, and community builders developing projects that strengthen Africa's cultural infrastructure, expand opportunities for others, and reimagine African stories through art, technology, education, design, and innovation. Together, we're investing in the next generation of creators shaping the continent's creative future.

funds.name: Agile Fund for Regenerative Learning Communities
funds.subtitle: Seeking learning communities, free learning centers, and facilitators building regenerative, learner-centered spaces where a culture of peace takes root.
funds.description: The Agile Fund for Regenerative Learning Communities supports community-based free learning centers and the projects growing around them: spaces where learning is natural, learners of all ages set the pace, and culture is built before curriculum. The fund grows out of a decade of work by Edgar Gainko, co-founder of Educambiando, the first agile learning community in Mexico and Latin America, whose model has spread into a network of nearly one hundred facilitators and centers across Querétaro, Veracruz, Chiapas, Mexico City, Oaxaca, and the Yucatán Peninsula, and onward into Colombia and Chile. What began with children has become something wider: body-based learning, arts and music spaces, and territorial education programs like the consciousness campaigns protecting the Bacalar lagoon. The fund champions the shift from teacher-centered to partnership-based learning, where adults walk alongside learners and communities regenerate themselves from the inside out.

funds.name: AgroforestDAO Fund for Intergenerational Agriculture

funds.description: This fund backs the people growing the future from the ground up: food foresters, seed stewards, and community cultivators restoring abundance through living systems. At the intersection of syntropic agroforestry, ancestral memory, and cyber-coordination, it supports projects building a rooted network society—one shaped by seasonal rhythms, intergenerational wealth, and ecological reciprocity.

funds.name: AI & Society Fund
funds.subtitle: Impact grants for research, education, and action to help with the societal impact of AI on human life and purpose.
funds.description:
AI is restructuring work, identity, privacy, and purpose faster than institutions can study it. This fund supports projects working on addressing the societal impact of AI across three arms: research, education, and community outreach. From biodata security and neurorights to job pivots and purpose-finding, it funds the people mapping what AI is doing to us while there is still time to steer.
SEEK/FIND aims to facilitate people who are leaning into their curiosity. As AI completely disrupts the work landscape, society has to adjust, and people need to pivot from deriving meaning from their jobs to finding meaning within themselves. Finding purpose comes from following a thread of curiosity (and intuition) and seeing where it takes us. The antidote to fear is curiosity <3
**Recipients of the fund grant SEEK/FIND a non-exclusive license to publish, display, or showcase the funded work on the organization's digital platforms, with full accreditation and attribution provided to the authors.

funds.name: AI Film 3 Fund for Frontier Storytellers
funds.subtitle: Backing AI-native storytellers with funding, a festival premiere, and a real path to the big screen.
funds.description: Every AI filmmaker eventually hits the same wall: the work is finished, and there's nowhere for it to play. This fund exists to tear that wall down. Every project curated here plugs into a working ecosystem: AI Film 3, the in-real-life festival now in its third year championing AI filmmakers, musicians, and artists in public, and LUMINA Cinema, a distribution pathway that puts AI-made films on real cinema screens and pays the creators behind them. The fund is led by PJ Way, founder of Prometheus Productions, who created AI Film 3 after watching AI give his daughter the power to tell stories beyond the limits of her physical ability. That origin still steers everything here: other funds offer money, this one offers a career on-ramp.

funds.description: The AI Filmmaking Fund seeks projects that leverage generative AI to explore new forms of cinematic storytelling. We believe generative AI is poised to redefine the boundaries of creativity, democratize content creation, and reshape how stories are told and experienced. Our mission is to celebrate and support creators at the vanguard of this new era of filmmaking.

funds.name: Aleph Zero Fund for Privacy Pioneers
funds.subtitle: Seeking projects at the frontier privacy built with Aleph Zero
funds.description: The Aleph Zero Fund supports projects that elevate and normalize privacy as an essential human right and ignite innovation within the Aleph Zero ecosystem. By supporting artists, coders, and creators who utilize Aleph Zero's secure and private infrastructure, this fund seeks to inspire a global perspective where privacy is embedded in every digital interaction. Examples of the projects we aim to fund include privacy-centric messaging apps that ensure user conversations remain confidential, immersive art installations that explore the impact of surveillance, scientific research focused on cryptographic advancements, and cultural experiences that raise awareness about data sovereignty.

funds.name: Anarchists United Studios Genre Film Completion Fund
funds.subtitle: Providing resources for filmmakers in the final stages of completing short-form or feature length genre films
funds.description:
//b52a6191a6a50af956eb089c76ac973d.cdn.bubble.io/f1776183629475x407685481215105600/richtext_content.png
The Anarchists Studios Genre Film Completion Fund provides resources for filmmakers in the final stages of completing narrative short-form or feature-length genre films (sci-fi, action, horror, or thriller). Anarchists United is dedicated to supporting filmmakers whose work in front of and behind the camera aims to serve narratives that further Artistry, Diversity, and Equity and uplift those from historically underserved communities.
Anarchists United recognizes that independent filmmaking is hard at any stage, but can be particularly difficult as filmmaking teams are racing towards the finish line. Anarchists United Studios Genre Film Completion Fund is intended to help provide much-needed support to bring polish and refinement to films as they move through post-production.
ABOUT ANARCHISTS UNITED
Founded by filmmaker Lilly Wachowski, Anarchists United aims to elevate the next generation of filmmakers whose work uses genre storytelling in inventive and unexpected ways. Anarchists United is dedicated to creating a holistically integrated and sustainable economic and artistic ecosystem to support ARTISTRY, DIVERSITY and EQUITY in media.
Artistry: Championing creative vision over corporate dictates. In a consolidating media landscape where buyers are making their mandates increasingly narrow, Anarchists United will support creative freedom and adventurous choices by directors, writers and others in media.‍
Diversity: Committing to radically support creatives from historically underserved communities in front of and behind the camera. People of color, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, older creatives, people with disabilities, and the economically challenged are all among the cohorts that Anarchists United will promote.
Equity: Democratizing the economic upside of productions. Every person who works on AU projects, above the line and below the line, will receive a share.
ANARCHISTS UNITED x HARBOR PICTURE COMPANY SPECIAL PRIZE
In addition to the Fund, the top winner will also receive a post-production package that includes color grading and sound services thanks to a generous donation from Harbor Picture Company. Details will be provided if you win. Terms and Conditions apply.

funds.name: Apam Unity and Progress Fund
funds.subtitle: Empowering Gomoa Apam youth to tell powerful digital stories that preserve and evolve coastal Ghanaian culture.
funds.description: The Apam Unity and Progress Fund supports talented young creators from Gomoa Apam who use accessible digital tools to celebrate, preserve, and reimagine coastal Fante culture. From documenting Akwambo festivals and fishing traditions to creating photography, graphic art, reels, and animations, this fund invests in youth-led digital storytelling that transforms local pride into globally visible cultural narratives while strengthening community identity and creative confidence.

funds.name: ApeChain Community Fund for Bold Builders
funds.subtitle: A community-powered fund backing fearless creators building the future of art, technology, and culture on ApeChain.
funds.description: The ApeChain Community Fund puts the power in the hands of the APE community to find and fund the most impactful projects across the ecosystem. By matching contributions from fans with support from ApeChain, this Fund amplifies creator success and deepens grassroots participation. From tools and games to culture-shaping experiences, we back the builders shaping the next chapter of the ApeCoin story.

funds.name: Apollo Fund for the New Renaissance
funds.subtitle: Seeking multidisciplinary projects that unite art, technology, culture, and community to catalyze a new renaissance of human creativity.
funds.description: The Apollo Fund for the New Renaissance supports artists, technologists, educators, and cultural builders who dissolve the boundaries between disciplines in pursuit of something greater. We believe the most transformative breakthroughs emerge when art, science, technology, and culture cross-pollinate within vibrant communities united by shared purpose. Inspired by the spirit of apprenticeship, experimentation, and collective creation, this fund champions incubatory projects that cultivate new cultural movements, forge unexpected collaborations, and help lay the foundations for a flourishing renaissance of human creativity.

funds.name: Artisanal Intelligence Fund
funds.subtitle: Supporting makers, designers, and researchers keeping endangered craft traditions alive by placing them in the hands of a new generation.
funds.description: The most endangered knowledge in the world is not in books or archives; it lives in the hands, eyes, and bodies of master craftspeople aging without successors, and the best way to preserve it is not to document it but to put it in contact with new practitioners who will carry it forward in their own way. Artisanal Intelligence Fund backs the makers, designers, researchers, and filmmakers doing exactly that: engaging endangered making traditions as living practice, from kasuri weaving in Kurume to silk looms in Okinawa, and translating ancestral knowledge into how we design, build, and live today. The fund is led by Anneleen Bertels and Waldo De Keersmaecker, founders of KNOTTO, who curated Artisanal Intelligence for the EU Pavilion at the Osaka World Expo, matching five European artists with five Japanese master craftspeople in residencies whose work is now touring six countries.

funds.name: Artist-Run Spaces Fund for Cooperative Culture
funds.subtitle: Supporting artist-run spaces and the open-source infrastructure that connects them into a global network.
funds.description: Independent art spaces are where culture actually gets made: collectively, locally, and usually without funding. This fund supports artist-run initiatives, the performers, painters, musicians, and organizers who animate them, and the open-source software (CoCoSo) being built to help them organize, become visible, and find one another. It runs on a sister-solidarity model: spaces with funding are matched with spaces without, so the network grows by mutual aid rather than competition. Learn more about the network at https://www.artistrun.space

funds.name: Artists Village Fund for Creative Resilience in Kaduna
funds.subtitle: Fueling creative resilience in Kaduna, Nigeria by supporting artists who transform adversity into collective healing and civic imagination.
funds.description: The Artists Village Fund champions creative resilience in Kaduna—backing artists who use dance, color, storytelling, and performance to build bridges across divides. In a region where resources are scarce and expression is often stifled, this fund supports cultural interventions that offer joy, safety, and solidarity. By empowering local creators to gather, imagine, and act together, we invest in a future shaped by artistic courage and communal care.

funds.name: Artizen Fund for Human Creativity
funds.subtitle: Seeking projects at the frontier of art, science, technology and culture.
funds.description: The Artizen Match Fund seeks projects at the frontier of art, science, technology and culture. Open to creators of every kind, this general match fund supports all forms of human creativity. Our mission is to champion the visionaries and problem-solvers who make a positive impact in the world.

funds.name: Artizen Tools Fund for Independent Builders
funds.subtitle: Backing independent builders who make Artizen legible: open tools, dashboards, bots, and datasets anyone can use and fork.
funds.description: Every living platform eventually grows a second layer: the independent tools that let people see the whole game. Artizen funds art, science, and culture, but the tool layer on top of it is still thin. This fund pays for the next bricks. The reference case is artizen.fyi, an unaffiliated open-source leaderboard that crawls the platform and turns seasons, funds, drives, and boosts into public pages anyone can search. We back independent engineers, designers, and data artists shipping the missing public layer: better data, better search, bots that explain a Fund Drive, season dashboards, and open datasets other builders can fork. Every tool must be publicly usable and open or fair-source, built to make Artizen more legible without extracting from the communities on it. Independence is the point. The platform is the canvas. Now we fund the people painting on it.

funds.name: ArtTech Fund for Civilizational Retelling
funds.subtitle: Funding immersive storytellers using VR/AR and emerging tech to revive ancestral cultures and reimagine civilizational history for a new generation.
funds.description: The ArtTech Fund for Civilizational Retelling supports visionary creators who use immersive technologies to revive local cultures, folklore, and ancient knowledge systems for modern audiences. From VR time-travel experiences to gamified traditional board games and experimental music rooted in heritage, this Fund accelerates a cultural renaissance across the Global South—empowering communities to tell their stories in their own voice and reawaken shared human consciousness.

funds.name: ATÉ CHÁ Fund: Lisbon Tea Week & Festival + Azores TeaCompression
funds.subtitle: A platform for tea culture: a gathering to move the renaissance forward, with a tea passport to carry it into the world.
funds.description: The Até Chá Fund supports a culture of ceremony, presence, listening, and value flowing back to origin, and the creators of that culture: syntropic and permaculture farmers, slow-trade merchants, tea houses and spaces of ceremony and wellness, and the artists, musicians, and facilitators whose gifts pair well with tea. It begins with Lisbon's first tea festival this October and a TeaCompression in the Azores.

funds.name: Atonuv Records Fund for New Sounds
funds.subtitle: Seeking audacious artists redefining music
funds.description: In the heart of Detroit, where the bold are born and boundaries burn, Atonuv Records calls forth the sonic pioneers. Let rhythm rebel and melodies morph. This fund empowers musicians and composers who defy genres and craft unprecedented sounds, offering them free studio sessions with the acclaimed audio engineer and producer Scott Murphy at Atonuv Records. Recipients also gain the opportunity to perform live in Detroit, showcasing their innovative music in a city known for its rich musical heritage. We are seeking artists who operate outside recognized genres, whose work defies easy categorization, and who are eager to explore musical territories yet unheard.

funds.name: Automata Fund for Embodied Robotics
funds.subtitle: Supporting bold creators advancing embodied AI through real-world robots that fight, perform, create, and collaborate with humans.
funds.description: The Automata Fund for Embodied Robotics supports projects exploring how intelligent machines move, adapt, and interact in the physical world. Inspired by the ethos behind Ultimate Fighting Bots, this Fund champions robotics as a living, cultural medium. From combat robotics and competitive leagues to expressive machines that dance, make art, or assist humans, we seek projects that treat the real world as a training ground where failure, friction, and interaction drive evolution. This is where embodied AI meets consequence, creativity, and human connection.

funds.name: Autonomous Mutant Fund
funds.subtitle: For genre-splicers, worldbuilders, body hackers, and radical soul freaks charting new cultural territory.
funds.description: There is no radical art, only radical people. Autonomous Mutant Fund backs DIY-or-die worldbuilders and flesh alchemists working in a laboratory of genres to synthesize new modes of being: inventors, hybrid beings, radical experimentalists whose expression defies the regulated barriers of community guidelines, the medical establishment, and institutional taste. These projects are ecstatic expressions of the underground from people re-routing our collective trajectory toward liberation, from the bottom up.

funds.name: Autonomy Fund for First Nations
funds.subtitle: Supporting First Nations-led initiatives and solidarity projects building territorial autonomy, mutual aid networks, collective governance, and regenerative futures.
funds.description: The Autonomy Fund for First Nations supports projects advancing territorial autonomy, community self-determination, and regenerative ways of living rooted in First Nations leadership. We champion creators, organizers, educators, and communities building systems of mutual aid, direct democratic governance, land stewardship, peacebuilding, and international solidarity. Through locally grounded yet globally connected initiatives, we seek to help seed innovative, liberatory, and sustainable paradigms for the future.

funds.name: Backdrop Fund for Builders
funds.subtitle: Seeking open source projects at the frontier of AI and crypto.
funds.description: The Backdrop Fund seeks open source projects at the frontier of AI and crypto. We believe in fostering a vibrant community of open source developers who are pushing the boundaries of these technologies. Our mission is to assist those who dare to take the big swings, transform the wildest ideas into kick-ass open source projects, and contribute to the ever-evolving AI and crypto ecosystems. Selected projects not only receive financial backing but are accepted into Backdrop's Builders program, aimed at promoting innovation and pushing the boundaries of technology.

funds.name: Based Creators Fund for New Onchain Creators
funds.subtitle: Supporting artists, musicians, who create on Base for the first time.
funds.description: The Based Creators Fund is for the artists, musicians, developers, designers, writers, animators, video producers, and cultural producers dedicated to their craft—and ready to build onchain. Designed for creators new to Base, this Fund backs those using blockchain to share their work, grow their audience, and shape culture. With support from Base distribution channels, we’re helping creators find their voice and claim their value in a new creative economy.

funds.name: Beyonders Fund for Peacemaking
funds.subtitle: Supporting projects that bring people from communities in conflict into contact, dialogue, or collaboration
funds.description: The Beyonders Fund for Peacemaking supports organizers, artists, educators, technologists, and community builders creating real conditions for peace. We fund projects that reduce violence, strengthen trust, foster dialogue, and build lasting infrastructure for cooperation across divides. Our mission is to surface the beyonders already growing futures that politics cannot yet imagine.

funds.name: Biopunk Fund for Creative Science
funds.subtitle: Funding biology's outsiders: independent scientists doing creative, community-driven research in labs the institutions forgot to build.
funds.description: Modern science has no third spaces. You can consume it or you can professionalize it, but there is almost nowhere left to simply play. The Biopunk Fund backs the independent scientists building those spaces: a worldwide network of community labs anchored by one of San Francisco's largest, the Primordia microgrant program already funding teams in six countries, hackathons where you don't pay to play, and fellowships for longer arcs of inquiry. We believe breakthrough science starts as play, not as a grant proposal. Our community has already sparked menstrual stem cell research, robotic lab automation, and living wall panels that absorb carbon. If you're doing real science outside the institutions, in public, with your community, this fund is your first check.

funds.name: BioSonic Fund for Neurodivergent Creators
funds.subtitle: Supporting neurodivergent founders, wellness innovators, and musical artists building sound, somatic, and bio-strategic tools for sustainable human performance.
funds.description: The next generation of great companies and creative projects will not be built on hustle culture; they will be built on mental clarity, sensory regulation, and biological readiness. BioSonic Fund backs the neurodivergent founders, wellness innovators, and musical artists proving it: creators weaving acoustic therapy, somatic design, and neuro-inclusive frameworks into how we work, heal, and perform. The fund is led by Karen Ovelar, a business strategist, musical artist, and wellness practitioner in Florianópolis who left a successful crypto career after burnout, found her way back through the handpan, and now designs bio-strategy frameworks that protect founders from the very fire she walked through, organizing sound healing, meditation, and body awakening gatherings for the entrepreneurs and neurodivergent minds of Brazil's fastest-growing startup coast.

funds.name: Bloom Fund for Local Action
funds.subtitle: Seeking place-based coalitions across Bloom Network's nearly 60 local chapters worldwide: the farmers, artists, watershed stewards, and neighbors building the communities they want to live in, together.
funds.description: Since 2008, Bloom Network has been quietly proving that healthy, resilient communities are built by creatives: the musicians, makers, farmers, and organizers who treat life where they live as a shared work of art. Across nearly 60 local chapters on six continents, Blooms host farmers markets, song circles, watershed restoration days, language schools, and pop-up kitchens, weaving businesses, mutual aid groups, and everyday neighbors into coalitions none of them could form alone. Traditional funding rarely reaches this kind of work; it funds single-issue projects, not living networks. The Bloom Fund exists to change that. It gives Local Bloom chapters, cross-chapter collaborations, and network-wide initiatives the resources to formalize the creative projects already stirring on the ground: regional watershed mapping, indigenous song circles, community currency systems that let neighbors exchange their gifts, and cultural gatherings that dissolve the silos between food, housing, and land. Every funded project is documented publicly on Bloom's platform, so what works in one community becomes a trail marker for the next. This is not a bet on a future that might arrive. It is fuel for one already well underway.

funds.name: Bonfires Fund for Agentic Creativity
funds.subtitle: Supporting creators building AI agents that amplify human creativity—while experimenting with transparent, human-guided AI governance.
funds.description: The Bonfires Fund for Agentic Creativity supports the growing wave of people building AI agents—AI collaborators, assistants, and teammates—using new, accessible tools like OpenClaw, Bonfires, and other modern agent frameworks. We’re interested in agents that expand what humans can create, not replace them. From creative partners and research aides to collective sensemaking tools, this fund backs projects that treat AI as a multiplier for human imagination. It also treats evaluation itself as an experiment: AI agents assist in reviewing and reasoning about submissions, while final decisions remain firmly in human hands—transparent, inspectable, and accountable.

funds.name: BONK Fund for Decentralized Creators
funds.subtitle: Fueling BONK’s rise as Web3’s community coin by funding multi-chain, DeFi, and blockchain gaming projects.
funds.description: The BONK Fund seeks to empower creators who are building multi-chain, DeFi, and gaming projects that integrate $BONK, the community coin of Web3. As BONK continues to grow with over 400,000 holders and hundreds of integrations, this fund aims to drive its expansion into new ecosystems, promote decentralized finance, and support blockchain-based gaming projects that enhance the utility of $BONK as an in-game currency.

funds.name: Bread Fund for the Solidarity Economy
funds.subtitle: Supporting cooperatives, collectives, and commons-builders creating an economy where everyone rises together.
funds.description: Bread Coop has spent years proving that solidarity economics actually work: a cooperative community whose BREAD token turns a shared treasury into steady funding for post-capitalist projects, with over $500K circulating and grants flowing monthly to builders like Citizen Wallet, Traditional Dream Factory, and Regen Coordination. Now they're bringing their Solidarity Fund to Artizen to reach beyond their own network and back the wider movement: worker cooperatives, mutual aid networks, artist and developer collectives, union organizing tools, and community spaces building democratic alternatives to venture-backed everything. The fund is led by Unai and the Bread Coop team, whose conviction is simple: the commons don't fund themselves, so we built a machine that does.

funds.name: Bright Codes Fund for Earth Hackers
funds.subtitle: For creators working at the intersection of ecology and technology, crafting new codes for a living planet.
funds.description: The Bright Codes Fund supports creators using technology to protect, uplift, and regenerate the natural world. We back those daring enough to shift the cultural trajectory—projects born from reverence for nature and driven by love over profit. If your work reveals hidden impacts or builds systems that heal the Earth, this fund is for you.

funds.name: Búan_fund for Nature Restoration Éire
funds.subtitle: Optimising for biodiversity | Funding land stewardship
funds.description:
If you are working to restore nature and optimise for biodiversity anywhere across Ireland, we want to hear from you.
Búan' is grounded in empirical research, which informs stewardship agreements tailored to each property. These agreements identify the most impactful actions that can be taken—whether that’s planting native trees, managing water levels, removing invasive species, or sometimes simply letting nature take its course.
We want to see hundreds of applications and create a network of biodiversity reservoirs that stretch across the country, protecting and restoring ecosystems at scale.
We don't claim ownership of any land/ actions/ impact etc, nor do we infer any ownership on through tokenisation or similar mechanisms. With the landowner’s and others full consent, we may explore tokenising stewardship agreements, where agreed-upon actions are backed by the robust evidence gathered.

funds.name: Bubble Fund for No-Code Innovators
funds.subtitle: Empowering creators to build transformative AI-powered apps without code, using Bubble's intuitive development platform.
funds.description: The Bubble Fund supports visionary creators harnessing the power of Bubble’s no-code platform to build impactful, AI-powered applications. By providing financial backing to innovative projects, this fund accelerates the creation of powerful software solutions without the barriers of traditional coding. Unlock your potential, bring your ideas to life, and transform industries—all without writing a single line of code.

funds.name: BuildAfrica Fund for African Builders and Trade
funds.subtitle: Putting web3 to work for real African trade: shopkeepers, cross-border traders, artists, and the builders who serve them.
funds.description: Web3 in Africa succeeds when it expands real trade and real opportunity, not when it stays confined to a technical niche. This fund backs the shopkeeper in Nairobi accepting stablecoins, the trader moving goods across borders who needs faster settlement, the artist minting work for a global audience, and the builder shipping the tools that make all of it possible. It exists to put resources directly into the hands of the people bringing African commerce and creativity onchain.

funds.name: Burning Man Arts Fund
funds.subtitle: Fueling bold, participatory art that embodies the Burning Man ethos—whether on the open playa of Black Rock City or in communities around the world.
funds.description: The Burning Man Arts Fund supports visionary artists who push the boundaries of interactive, community-driven art. Whether crafting large-scale installations for Black Rock City, designing the next awe-inspiring Temple, or bringing the spirit of Burning Man to the wider world, this fund champions works that foster connection, self-expression, and radical participation. Projects should spark engagement, embrace the challenges of their environment, and leave a lasting impact.

funds.name: Cabin Fund for Regenerative Art
funds.subtitle: Funding large-scale installations, sculptures, and earthworks that foster community and regenerate the natural world.
funds.description: Cabin Fund supports creators who produce large-scale, architectural installations, sculptures, and earthworks that foster multi-generational communities and help regenerate the natural world. Your canvas? Neighborhood Zero, Elkenmist, or any neighborhood in the Cabin directory. We envision a world where art and nature integrate seamlessly to create transformative experiences that deepen our connection with the environment, our community, and ourselves. Inspired by the immersive installations of Burning Man, Meow Wolf, Cadillac Ranch, and Naoshima art island, we aim to commission groundbreaking works that will establish Cabin as a global destination for community-driven, regenerative art.

funds.name: Caffeine Fund for the Self-Writing Internet
funds.subtitle: Fueling creators building art, apps, and tools with Caffeine—ushering in the era of the self-writing internet.
funds.description: The Caffeine Fund supports visionary creators using Caffeine to build self-writing apps that spark cultural, technological, or social transformation. From hyperlocal networks to decentralized tools for global impact, we champion creators who push the boundaries of what’s possible when AI, crypto, and human imagination converge.

funds.name: Capitol Film Fund for African Storytellers
funds.subtitle: Seeking Creative Afrocentric-Based Projects led by Independent Storytellers and Artists Based in Nigeria and/or Africa.
funds.description:
The Capitol Film Fund for Afrocentric Storytellers exists to support and provide a launching pad for independent and indigenous Nigerian and African storytellers, artists, creatives and communities that are using film, storytelling, content creation and visual arts and technology who are committed to telling African stories, fostering pan Africanism and executing visually captivating narratives that is rooted deeply in Nigerian and African Heritage.
With a strong focus on Abuja-based creators and Nigerian-led projects, this Fund supports films and festivals that explore African history, culture, Afrofuturism, and contemporary realities but is also open to creators and storytellers from other Nations of Africa should your project be too irresistible for us to ignore.
Please also note that it is imperative that the lead creator(s) for a project must be Independent (not backed by a government or corporation) with a track record in storytelling and film and must incorporate film into the project idea and it’s entire process or experience.
By backing both emerging and experienced storytellers, this Fund aims to strengthen Nigeria’s indie film ecosystem and support African voices that are shaping the future of cinema.

funds.name: Catalyst Initiative for American Renewal
funds.subtitle: Revitalizing small-town and rural America by empowering local entrepreneurs to build the future from where they are.
funds.description:
The Catalyst Fund for American Renewal is a grant initiative dedicated to uplifting entrepreneurs and small businesses rooted in small cities and rural communities across the United States. These founders are building with purpose, aiming to hire locally and give back to their communities as they grow.
This fund provides grants to help founders take the next big step—whether it’s launching a new product to accelerate growth or hiring their first team to scale operations right in their community.

funds.name: Cine y Sonido Fund for Latin Storytellers
funds.subtitle: For Latin American filmmakers and sound artists making bold, political, community-rooted work that traditional markets overlook.
funds.description: Some of the most vital cinema and sound art being made today comes from Latin America, and much of it never reaches traditional markets. Cine y Sonido backs Latin American directors, screenwriters, and sound artists developing innovative work with a point of view: films that take formal and political risks, and sound works, experimental music, and scores that open spaces for people to connect, share ideas, and build together. The fund treats image and sound as two halves of one craft. It exists to give visibility and opportunity to emerging Latin American creators overlooked by conventional channels, with particular attention to projects that include women and gender-diverse communities.

funds.name: Clear Mind: Music + Mental Health Fund
funds.subtitle: Funding projects where innovative sound & art meets brain boosting, stress clearing and deeper community connection.
funds.description:
The Music + Healing Fund supports visionary creators (anywhere around the planet) using sound with live events or immersive experiences as a catalyst for collective well-being and creativity boosting.
From immersive sound baths to experimental wellness events, "nap concerts", and ... we back innovative projects that work to expand empathy and emotional resonance with a focus on live music and mental health.
We are in the middle of a mental health crisis in the USA and many other countries across the world. Combining that with the pre-existing loneliness epidemic, aging populations, and the growing lack of "third spaces" to experience live music or sound in a calm atmosphere, the result is a lot of unreleased stress. This is having a huge impact on mental health, body health, mood, decision making, and relationships.
This fund is open to all who explore the intersection of healing, sonic experience, and community transformation.
Think unusual concerts or sound baths, with innovative and immersive elements that help people clear stress and really feel good in their brain and body.
Use of technology is welcomed (think projections on the wall or ceiling), but also old-school methods are encouraged (circle post event to talk, journaling, "release a fear" station", mini breath work, shake it out, movement, etc.). Guided meditation with sound bath & movement practice?
What is your innovative idea to help clear stress, boost creativity, and improve mental health?

funds.name: Collective Women’s Fund for Creative Solidarity
funds.subtitle: Supporting deeply creative women who gather, experiment, and build culture together.
funds.description: The Collective Women’s Fund for Creative Solidarity champions women creators who are actively shaping culture through shared imagination and collective practice. We support interdisciplinary artists, organizers, and builders whose work expands creative expression, strengthens community bonds, and advances non-patriarchal futures. From gatherings to workshops to collaborative experiments, this Fund fuels women who create — and create together.

funds.name: Commons Fund for Public Goods Pioneers
funds.subtitle: Seeking projects that develop, explore, or celebrate public goods.
funds.description: The Commons Fund seeks projects that develop, explore, or celebrate public goods in diverse fields such as art, science, technology, and design. We champion visionary creators who demonstrate a commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation in the public goods sphere. Curated projects will receive support of the Funding the Commons community and access to our network of practitioners, researchers, and creators, all striving for a world where public goods are celebrated and prioritized.

funds.name: Commons Fund for Regenerative Land Practices
funds.subtitle: Seeking hands-in-the-dirt creators practicing land stewardship, natural building, permaculture, and the traditional arts that keep wild places alive.
funds.description: housands of people are quietly doing the most important work on earth, taking care of it, and almost none of the money built for creativity ever reaches them. Off-grid homesteaders raising earthen walls by hand, permaculture designers restoring watersheds and growing food forests, wildland stewards holding ground against gas lines and copper mines, sculptors and wood carvers and land artists whose materials come from the places they protect. They rarely speak the language of institutions, and institutions rarely see them. This fund does. It supports active, land-based projects: natural and sustainable building, wilderness preservation, habitat restoration, and analog arts rooted in nature, from land art to documentary film that deepens our appreciation of wild places. It also champions the culture around the work, the barn raisings and sliding-scale workshops where builders teach builders and knowledge passes between generations. This is a fund for people building a life of ecological care and creative self-reliance directly on the land.

funds.name: Commons Hub Fund for Village Builders
funds.subtitle: Seeking creators building events, media, open-source tools, and shared infrastructure that turn local experiments into lasting commons.
funds.description: At an 1860s inn turned living lab in the Austrian Alps, Commons Hub Austria gathers artists, hackers, and tinkerers exploring how culture, governance, production, and community life can be held in common. We believe a commons grows one project at a time: when creators share what they build, every project becomes a foundation for the next. This fund seeds projects that draw on the Hub's spaces, fablab, gardens, and event infrastructure, from residencies, unconferences, and documentaries to open-source software, fabrication designs, and educational resources, and that leave behind outputs others can learn from, adapt, and reuse. Our goal is a lightweight engine for the ecosystem around the Hub: early-stage projects gain traction here, and local experiments grow into something lasting, shared with the world.

funds.name: Community Network Fund
funds.subtitle: Seeking regenerative communities, ecological projects, and educational spaces that bridge people, cultures, and nature to cultivate a more connected and resilient world.
funds.description: The Community Network Fund supports communities and projects that serve as living bridges between people and nature, locals and travelers, and traditional and emerging ways of life. Inspired by a lifelong journey through ecovillages, educational centers, environmental projects, and cultural communities around the world, this fund seeks to strengthen the relationships, knowledge-sharing, and collaboration that help regenerate both ecosystems and human connection. We believe the future emerges through networks of communities learning from one another, preserving local wisdom, and co-creating resilient ways of living in harmony with the Earth. Through this fund, we aim to support the people and places building the foundations of a more regenerative world.

funds.name: Conectxai Fund for Agroforestry and Solarpunk Living
funds.subtitle: Backing the practitioners already living the solarpunk future: agroforestry, bees, springs, and self-built abundance.
funds.description: In the Brazilian rainforest and beyond, people are already living the future the rest of us theorize about: producing their own energy, water, and food; growing agroforestry systems that feed people while the forest returns; keeping native stingless bees; guarding springs; and teaching the next generation to do the same. Conectxai Fund supports these active practitioners, uniting ancestral knowledge of the land with renewable technology and decentralized tools, and expanding what is good and regenerative.

funds.name: Confession Sessions Fund for Underground Music Rituals
funds.subtitle: Supporting underground DJs, producers, VJs, and performance artists who transform unconventional spaces into community-driven, high-concept rituals.
funds.description: Confession Sessions fuels creators reclaiming the dancefloor from commercial gatekeeping. We support boundary-pushing music, visuals, and performance hosted in heritage or unconventional spaces, elevating grassroots talent with festival-grade production while centering community ritual, catharsis, and collective experience.

funds.name: Console Fund For Community Builders
funds.subtitle: Seeking community-driven projects that empower collaboration and co-creation.
funds.description:
The Console Fund seeks community-driven projects that empower their members to collaborate and co-create new products, new art, and new experiences. We believe in the power and importance of private digital spaces built specifically for web3 communities where ideas can blossom and innovation can thrive. Through this fund, we hope to support initiatives that leverage the unique Web3 features of Console, thereby fostering a new era of community engagement.
​
📖 Read Essay: Get Funded to Build Better Communities

funds.name: Constellation Fund for Explosive Creativity
funds.subtitle: Empowering artists and technologists to illuminate the future of Web3 through explosive creativity.
funds.description: The Constellation Fund invites creators of every kind—from artists and musicians to filmmakers and coders—to submit projects that celebrate the wild spirit of creativity. Constellation is a decentralized network that empowers anyone to build the future of Web3 with fast, feeless transactions. This fund supports any creative expression designed to meme Constellation, the $DAG token, or our ecosystem of products. Whether it’s through vibrant artwork, engaging videos, animated gifs, wearable art like t-shirts and hats, essays and articles, or dynamic online experiences, this fund supports creators who highlight the potential of Web3. The goal is to create captivating, visually appealing works that resonate widely, drawing more eyes to the transformative possibilities that Constellation brings to the digital frontier.

funds.name: Coral Commons Fund for Reef Restoration
funds.subtitle: Empowering global creators to restore coral reefs through decentralized science and community-driven innovation.
funds.description: The Coral Commons Fund for Reef Restoration, launched by MesoReefDAO, supports global reef regeneration with a focus on low-to-middle-income countries. We back creators using decentralized science, marine biology, regenerative aquaculture, cultural storytelling, and emerging tech to heal our oceans. From community scientists to artists and engineers, we believe open-source innovation is key to resilient reef ecosystems.

funds.name: Courage Fund for Visionary Artists
funds.subtitle: Empowering visionary creators who pursue inspiring, inventive work with courage, conviction, and an unwavering creative spirit.
funds.description: The Courage Fund for Visionary Artists celebrates creators who dare to dream big and make work that moves us. Whether experimental or emotional, poetic or political, this fund honors those who pursue their vision with persistence and heart—despite all barriers. We back artists who refuse to quit, who turn obstacles into inspiration, and who remind us what's possible. We are also looking for sponsors who can offer services, mentorships to the artist projects as well as some money to this fund.

funds.name: Creative Enterprise Fund
funds.subtitle: For creators building ventures: creativity with a credible path to sustainability.
funds.description: Most creators do not lack talent; they lack access to resources, meaningful networks, and the bridge from craft to livelihood. Creative Enterprise Fund backs creators shaping the future of the creative economy through art, technology, and innovation: launching fashion brands, developing creative software, producing immersive experiences, preserving culture, or building new tools for other creators, always with a clear path toward long-term sustainability and meaningful impact.

funds.name: Creative Republic Fund
funds.subtitle: Supporting artists, designers, makers, and cultural entrepreneurs building the future of African creativity through original work, cultural innovation, and community impact.
funds.description: The Creative Republic Fund supports the artists, makers, designers, and creative entrepreneurs shaping the future of culture across Ghana and West Africa. From fashion brands and artisan products to community arts initiatives and youth-led cultural movements, we champion original work that celebrates creativity, strengthens local economies, and inspires new generations. We believe creators are essential cultural infrastructure, and this fund exists to help them access the resources, visibility, and support needed to grow their impact.

funds.name: Creative Wellness Fund for Community Healing
funds.subtitle: Heal the Self. Shift the Capital.
funds.description:
In Season 6, we rooted our mission in the collective healing of Kaduna. But for Season 7, we are evolving. True, lasting change doesn’t start in a crowd; it starts within. You must be the change you want to see.
Based in the fast-paced, high-pressure environment of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) Abuja, the Creative Wellness Fund is dedicated to the belief that community healing begins with the self. We are here to support creative projects, artistic interventions, and wellness innovations that help individuals look inward, process trauma, manage anxiety, and cultivate inner peace.
We believe that a healthy society is simply a reflection of healthy, self-actualised individuals.

funds.name: Cross-Cultural Music Fund
funds.subtitle: Funding independent musicians who collaborate across cultures and borders.
funds.description: Some of the most alive music being made today happens where traditions meet: musicians from different cultures writing, playing, and recording together across every border that is supposed to separate them. This fund supports independent musicians and composers pursuing collaborations, in their own communities or around the world, so that more of that music gets made.

funds.name: Cryptoart Fund for Preservation & Practice
funds.subtitle: A community fund dedicated to stabilizing, preserving, and sustaining cryptoart practice through shared infrastructure, care, and collective stewardship.
funds.description: The Cryptoart Fund for Preservation & Practice supports artists, technologists, organizers, and educators who strengthen the conditions that allow cryptoart to endure. In a time of platform collapse and fragmentation, this fund prioritizes shared infrastructure, cultural memory, public access, and community care—ensuring individual artistic practice can continue without bearing the burden of preservation alone. Rooted in transparency and collective benefit, the fund invests in projects that sustain the cryptoart ecosystem for the long term.

funds.name: Cultivate Fund for Tea Houses and Trade Routes
funds.subtitle: Funding tea houses as community hubs and the caravans of storytellers and merchants who connect them.
funds.description:
In traditional Chinese medicine, tea is the first medicine: it calms, focuses, detoxifies and opens the door to deeper healing.
Most cultures in the world know tea and wherever it appeared, it became a ritual for humans to connect, the flavour of home.
Storytelling used to be deeply connected with tea, globally.
The Cultivate Fund supports two kinds of projects that carry that spirit into community life: local tea houses as living hubs, creative spaces, galleries, wellness rooms, and workshops, especially in restored historical buildings and weaving local history into their foundations, and the traveling caravans of storytellers, weavers, merchants, and artists who connect these spaces into a network of trust, culture, and regenerative trade.

funds.name: Cultural ARchive Fund for Spatial Storytellers
funds.subtitle: Supporting augmented reality creators who preserve, activate, and reimagine local culture through spatial storytelling in public space.
funds.description: The Cultural ARchive Fund supports creators using augmented reality to document, preserve, and activate cultural stories in the physical world. From historic neighborhoods and main streets to murals, galleries, and public plazas, this fund champions projects that turn cities into living archives. We believe AR can expand access to culture, empower artists and civic partners, and create new forms of public art that are place-based, participatory, and future-proofed for generations to come.

funds.name: Cultural Visionaries Fund
funds.subtitle: Fair compensation for the artists, educators, and knowledge keepers carrying culture forward.
funds.description: The people creating our most meaningful cultural experiences, transformational musicians, facilitators, Indigenous knowledge keepers, storytellers, and community educators, are chronically underfunded despite the depth of their impact. Cultural Visionaries Fund exists to change that: making it easier for communities to directly support the creators who inspire growth, connection, and stewardship, and building a lasting model for investing in the people who carry culture forward.

funds.name: CXN Fund for Techstars
funds.subtitle: Empowering Techstars alumni to innovate at the crossroads of technology, culture, and community.
funds.description: The CXN Fund supports startups within the Techstars ecosystem, promoting projects that thrive at the intersection of technology, culture, and community. With a vision for a more dynamic, community-owned internet, this fund fuels the mavericks who push boundaries and create impactful products. Whether web3 or not, the CXN DAO champions founders ready to build the future, providing the resources and community to turn groundbreaking ideas into reality.

funds.name: Cyberdelic Fund for Expanding Consciousness
funds.subtitle: Fueling visionary projects that merge technology, art, and the exploration of consciousness to unlock human potential, creativity, and well-being.
funds.description: The Cyberdelic Fund fuels visionary projects at the convergence of art, technology, and consciousness, supporting those who pioneer immersive experiences that support human flourishing. In an era where we risk losing our innate abilities by letting technology take over, leading to a regression in human potential, we champion creators who design experiences that inspire transformation, and rekindle our connection to the natural world. Projects that reframe human-machine interaction while upholding humane ethics, well-being, and expansion. Our mission is to help shape a humane technological future where technology enhances our innate human capacities rather than replacing them. By integrating and cross-pollinating a collaborative ecosystem of tools, experiences, platforms and networks that unlock new paradigms of consciousness exploration.

funds.name: Dean's List Fund for Solana Builders
funds.subtitle: Advancing DAOs and Governance in Solana: Dean's List funds innovative projects.
funds.description: The Dean's List Fund is a visionary initiative dedicated to nurturing and expanding DAO and governance tooling in the Solana ecosystem. As an organization that has evolved from a Service DAO into a digital network state, Dean's List is committed to providing prosperity and opportunity for work in web3, fostering environments of aligned goals, and creating value on-chain in the form of service-oriented products for its clients. This Match Fund is an extension of that vision, aiming to support creators and projects that embody the ethos of DAOs, modular communities, open-source development, decentralization, and the drive to make Solana the most censorship-resistant network in the world.

funds.name: Decentralize Everything Fund for Web3 Public Goods
funds.subtitle: Funding the builders rebuilding the soul of web3: decentralization, shared ownership, and public infrastructure.
funds.description: The original promise of crypto was decentralization: shared ownership, censorship resistance, permissionless coordination outside centralized control. Much of that narrative has been damaged by greed, while AI concentrates power into ever fewer hands, which makes the decentralization layer more important than ever. This fund backs the people still building that future: open-source infrastructure, decentralized governance, community-owned networks, privacy-preserving tools, and coordination mechanisms, the hard, less-hyped, underfunded parts of the ecosystem.

funds.name: Deep South Creative Futures Fund
funds.subtitle: Investing in art, science, and technology projects that revitalise Cape Town’s Deep South.
funds.description: The Deep South Circles Creative Futures Fund supports artists, technologists, and community builders working to regenerate the Deep South of Cape Town—specifically the Muizenberg and Vrygrond areas. From waste innovation to art therapy, we champion projects that harness human creativity to heal, connect, and transform one of South Africa’s most economically divided regions.

funds.name: DeSci Asia Fund for Scientific Breakthroughs
funds.subtitle: Supporting DeSci builders, researchers, and communities across Asia advancing the future of decentralized science.
funds.description: The DeSci Asia Fund supports researchers, builders, DAOs, and scientific communities driving decentralized science across Asia. Since 2023, DeSci Asia has fostered the regional ecosystem through grants, meetups, symposiums, and partnerships with communities like DeSci Tokyo, DeSci India, DeSci SINO, and CancerDAO. This fund champions scientific breakthroughs, open collaboration, and community-driven innovation across the Asian DeSci ecosystem.

funds.name: DeSci Fund for Scientific Innovation
funds.subtitle: Empowering transformative scientific collaboration and open innovation through DeSci Nodes
funds.description: The DeSci Fund for Scientific Innovation is dedicated to advancing the future of science through the power of decentralized infrastructure. Emphasizing the importance of open access and collaboration, this fund supports projects that utilize DeSci Nodes to share original scientific research with the world. We aim to empower both established researchers and citizen scientists in their endeavors, fostering an ecosystem where scientific discovery is transparent, reproducible, and accessible to all. By backing initiatives that harness DeSci Nodes for everything from hypothesis registration to data sharing and manuscript publication, we’re not just funding projects; we’re investing in a more open, collaborative, and efficient scientific future.

funds.name: DeSpace Fund
funds.subtitle: Backing serious space exploration projects, from robotics to policy, built by people with real track records.
funds.description: Space work is unforgiving: it rewards rigor, credentials earned in the field, and ambitions scoped to what a team can actually deliver. DeSpace Fund supports serious space-exploration projects across robotics, engineering, simulation, science, and policy, led by founders with demonstrated experience and a clear sense of what this level of funding can realistically achieve. A published mathematical model of a propulsion system is fundable; the propulsion system itself is a different fund.

funds.name: deZine Fund for DIY Creators & Print Media Rebels
funds.subtitle: Empowering artists, activists, and zinesters using print to amplify stories, share knowledge, and inspire local action.
funds.description: The Zine Fund supports creators and communities committed to the art of independent publishing. From handmade fanzines and illustrated posters to experimental print collectives and distribution tools, this fund champions radical storytelling and decentralized publishing. Whether you're a comic artist self-publishing your first series or an organizer printing zines to fuel a movement, we’re here to help you hit print and find your people.

funds.name: Dharma Creator Fund
funds.subtitle: Funding sovereign creators who weave astrology, tarot, herbalism, and Ayurvedic wisdom into holistic digital experiences
funds.description: The Dharma Creator Fund is dedicated to fueling purpose-driven creators who are shaping the future of digital and physical communities through the lens of ancient wisdom and modern resilience.

funds.name: DreamPark Fund for Hybrid Worlds
funds.subtitle: Fueling creators who blend digital imagination with real-world wonder.
funds.description: The DreamPark Fund supports visionary builders crafting playful, tech-powered experiences that blur the boundary between the virtual and the physical. We champion creators inventing new forms of interactive spectacle—installations, games, robotics, mixed-reality adventures—that bring people together through immersive, story-driven worlds.

funds.name: Earth School Fund for Living Villages
funds.subtitle: Seeking projects that help people learn by living, growing, and building regenerative communities together.
funds.description: The Earth School Fund for Living Villages supports creators building a new model of education rooted in land, community, and lived experience. We believe some of life's most important lessons cannot be taught in classrooms—they are learned by growing food, building homes, stewarding ecosystems, and living in intentional communities. From eco-villages and regenerative farms to apprenticeships, cultural exchanges, and action-based learning programs, we champion projects helping people cultivate more resilient, self-reliant, and regenerative ways of living together. We believe the future will be grown, not built. This fund exists to support the people growing it.

funds.name: Eclipse Creator Fund for Onchain Innovation
funds.subtitle: Fueling creativity at massive scale by supporting creators who mint NFTs on Scope, Eclipse's premier launchpad.
funds.description: The Eclipse Creator Fund for Onchain Innovation champions creators pioneering the future of digital expression. This fund supports projects that leverage the power of Scope on Eclipse Mainnet, the Ethereum-Solana hybrid layer combining performant execution with unmatched liquidity. Together, let’s inspire new art forms and create cultural artifacts that redefine onchain creativity.

funds.name: Ecosystem Regeneration Fund
funds.subtitle: Fueling creators who restore the planet’s air, water, and soil through real, measurable ecosystem services.
funds.description: The Ecosystem Regeneration Fund supports projects that clean the air, revive waterways, and rebuild living soils. We seek bold creators restoring degraded landscapes, advancing reforestation, reversing desertification, and pioneering nature-based solutions that heal the planet from the ground up.

funds.name: Edge City Fund for Experimental Living
funds.subtitle: Supporting breakthrough projects in tech, science, art & culture emerging from Edge City's global popup villages.
funds.description:
Edge City is a society incubator — we gather curious, high-agency builders, researchers, scientists, and artists in month-long popup villages around the world. From Northern California to Patagonia to Thailand, our communities are living labs where new technologies, governance models, and ways of life get stress-tested in real time.
This fund backs the projects that emerge from that environment. We're looking to resource the experiments, tools, research, and creative work that carry Edge City's energy forward - things that wouldn't exist without the collisions and collaborations that happen when brilliant people live and build together. If you've been part of an Edge City gathering, or if your work is aligned with our community's mission of advancing human flourishing, this fund is for you.

funds.name: Embodied Dance & Nature Fund
funds.subtitle: Supporting artists and activists who use the body to reconnect people with nature through ecology and community
funds.description: The Embodied Dance in Nature Fund supports the wellbeing of the person, so it can connect with others and give back to nature. It involves movement artists, activists, ecosomatic processes who dance with the Earth—feet in the mud, spines swaying like trees, breath rising and falling with the waves. We fund work that treats nature not as backdrop but as collaborator, listening to the language of forests, rivers, deserts, mountains, and oceans. Through ecology, ritual and somatic wisdom, These artists remind us: the body is not separate from the land, it is of it.

funds.name: Embodied Mastery Fund for Living Lineages
funds.subtitle: Seeking lifelong practitioners preserving and transmitting the world's great embodied traditions through movement, craft, and direct human teaching.
funds.description: The Embodied Mastery Fund supports the wisdom keepers whose knowledge cannot be learned from a book alone. We believe the world's greatest movement traditions—martial arts, yoga, qi gong, dance, bodywork, tea ceremony, and countless other embodied crafts—are carried through living practice and direct transmission from teacher to student. This fund exists to help lifelong masters preserve their lineage by creating workshops, apprenticeships, retreats, recordings, books, and other resources that ensure their knowledge is passed to the next generation before it is lost.

funds.name: Emerald Fund for Regenerative Creators
funds.subtitle: Backing creators at the intersection of consciousness, culture, and regenerative design.
funds.description: Personal transformation and planetary regeneration reinforce one another: healthier people make healthier environments, and healthier environments make healthier people. Emerald Fund supports the creators proving it, artists, designers, educators, technologists, and community builders creating residencies, learning environments, immersive experiences, and cultural artifacts designed to hold and grow human potential, choosing collaboration over competition and stewardship over extraction.

funds.name: Emergence Fund for Evolutionary & Spiritual Philanthropy
funds.subtitle: Supporting creators pioneering regenerative culture, living myth, and consciousness-expanding systems.
funds.description: The Emergence Fund uplifts creators building culture at the edge of human evolution—projects blending regenerative design, evolutionary media, spiritual transformation, and collective intelligence. We support work that expands human potential, activates co-creation, and seeds systems that help humanity flourish in a thriving, interdependent future.

funds.name: Emergent Creativity Fund for Conscious Collaboration
funds.subtitle: Supporting creators who treat collaboration as a living system—blending intuition, experimentation, and nature-inspired intelligence.
funds.description: The Emergent Creativity Fund uplifts artists and technologists who explore creativity as an evolving ecosystem. Rooted in the ethos of the W8W Creative Hub in Costa Rica—a cultural space blending improvisation, consciousness research, and collaborative creation—this Fund supports global projects that honor process, community, and nature-based intelligence.

funds.name: Emotional Liberation Fund for Inner Work Spaceholders
funds.subtitle: Supporting high-integrity creators who deliver fast, safe, and scalable emotional healing through community-based inner work.
funds.description: The Emotional Liberation Fund exists to surface and support creators offering deeply effective inner work that helps people metabolize grief, trauma, shame, burnout, and loneliness. It's beyond talk, beyond theory, and beyond privilege. Inspired by years of firsthand experience navigating both transformative healing and broken systems, this fund prioritizes modalities that create meaningful emotional shifts in short periods of time, while remaining ethical, consent-based, and accessible to people anywhere with an internet connection. Our vision is a future where emotional support is as easy to find as clean water, no longer hidden in elite circles or locked behind wealth, but woven into everyday life through community, culture, and care.

funds.name: Expanding Horizons Fund
funds.subtitle: For creators who break the brain, bend the rules, and leave us stuck on loop wondering, “WTF did I just experience?”
funds.description: The Expanding Horizons Fund backs bold creators making the unthinkable real. This is for the rule-breakers, the absurdists, the subversive provocateurs expanding the limits of what creativity can be. We’re funding mindbending, visceral, and revolutionary projects that shatter expectations and burrow deep into your psyche - because the future doesn't come politely.

funds.name: Explorer Fund for Living Places
funds.subtitle: Seeking explorers, photographers, and storytellers documenting the overlooked places that make our world extraordinary.
funds.description: The Explorer Fund for Living Places supports photographers, explorers, storytellers, researchers, and local communities documenting the places that rarely appear on maps or in guidebooks. We believe every neighborhood, village, landscape, and community deserves to be seen through the eyes of the people who know it best. From remote villages and forgotten landmarks to everyday streets rich with local history, we champion creators building a living atlas of the world—one grounded in curiosity, authenticity, and human connection.

funds.name: Feÿtopia Fund for Extitutional Communities
funds.subtitle: Seeking art, technology, and cultural projects born from shared living experiments.
funds.description: The Feÿtopia Fund supports creators building at the edge of art, technology, and community life. We fund projects that emerge from real shared spaces: coliving houses, experimental villages, revived heritage properties, and seasonal communities where daily proximity sparks new culture. Our mission is to help artists, technologists, and community builders turn lived experiments into work the world can experience, adapt, and carry forward.

funds.name: Feÿtopia Fund for Extitutional Communities
funds.subtitle: Seeking art, technology, and cultural projects born from shared living experiments.
funds.description: The Feÿtopia Fund supports creators building at the edge of art, technology, and community life. We fund projects that emerge from real shared spaces: coliving houses, experimental villages, revived heritage properties, and seasonal communities where daily proximity sparks new culture. Our mission is to help artists, technologists, and community builders turn lived experiments into work the world can experience, adapt, and carry forward.

funds.name: Filecoin Fund for Cultural Preservation
funds.subtitle: Seeking creative projects that leverage decentralized storage technologies.
funds.description: The Filecoin Fund for Cultural Preservation supports projects that use decentralized storage technologies to archive, preserve, and disseminate cultural works. The web is an amazing engine for creative productivity –– putting the tools to create in the hands of billions. Yet, digital artifacts are fragile, and without dedicated efforts to preserve them, they risk being lost forever. Through projects that explore decentralized storage and web technologies, this Match Fund supports digital archiving efforts, emphasizing the critical role of decentralized storage technologies for safeguarding human creativity. We are particularly interested in projects that redefine digital librarianship, support data sovereignty for creators, and preserve a diverse array of artistic and culturally significant works.

funds.name: Film Fund for Independent Voices
funds.subtitle: Backing independent storytellers to pioneer new paths in filmmaking, ownership, and creating culture.
funds.description: The Film3 Fund champions independent voices and filmmakers with a passion for storytelling. We support documentaries, shorts, features, series, and frontier storytelling that push culture forward—powered by tools like NFTs, DAOs, and onchain funding. This is story-first filmmaking, driven by creators taking control of their art, their audience, and their future.

funds.name: FilmGate Fund for Interactive Storytelling
funds.subtitle: Seeking visionary creators eager to explore the boundless possibilities of narrative in the digital age.
funds.description: The FilmGate Fund for Interactive Storytelling seeks visionary creators eager to explore the boundless possibilities of narrative in the digital age. Rooted in the vibrant, diverse culture of Miami, we are committed to fostering inclusivity and innovation in film, interactive media, and immersive experiences. Our goal is to empower artists from a myriad of backgrounds, recognizing that diversity is not just our hallmark but our strength. Through this fund, we aim to support projects that both challenge and redefine storytelling, while celebrating the multicultural tapestry that makes our community unique.

funds.name: Flamingo Living Commons Fund for Albania
funds.subtitle: Caring for the people who care for Albania's rivers, wetlands, forests, and public spaces.
funds.description: Albania's landscapes are changing fast, and the activists, artists, and researchers working to protect its rivers, wetlands, and forests are running on passion with nowhere to rest. This fund supports projects that strengthen the wellbeing and resilience of the people working for environmental and social change in Albania: spaces and practices where creativity, embodiment, community care, and ecological action reinforce one another, because caring for those who care for the land is essential for long-term change.

funds.name: Flickr.org Fund for Digital Archives
funds.subtitle: Empowering cultural organizations to describe and share photography collections with the world.
funds.description: The Flickr.org Fund for Digital Archives is unlocking a bottleneck in cultural preservation: the challenge of describing digitized photography collections. This fund supports projects that experiment with generating baseline image descriptions—clearly marked as AI-generated—as a starting point for public engagement, education, and discovery. Our goal is to expand access to cultural heritage by helping communities publish more photography, more meaningfully, to Flickr.com.

funds.name: Founder Haus Fund for Human Resilience
funds.subtitle: Supporting Phoenix Founders rebuilding the future of human resilience across life, space, and community.
funds.description: The Founder Haus Fund for Human Resilience supports Phoenix Founders—seasoned builders who have built before, failed before, and risen again with deeper clarity about what truly matters. We believe the future belongs to founders who refuse burnout as the cost of success and instead design companies, communities, and technologies that sustain human life.
